name: Thor, Asgard's Avenger
oracle_text:
Flying
If another source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.
blocked_sentences: If another source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.

needs.what: an additive damage replacement on the replace_damage static: a `damage_addend` (N) beside or instead of `damage_multiplier`, so "it deals that much damage plus N instead" (Torbran, Thor) adds N to each damage event whose dealer matches `damage_source` (here controller you, exclude_self) and whose recipient is an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls (`affects_player: opponent` + `affects: {controller: opponent}`), with 616.1 ordering against multipliers left to the affected player/controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_damage only carries damage_multiplier, which the loader requires and refuses below 2, and player_statics folds every replace_damage into a single product; there is no addend the way replace_life_gain has gain_addend, so "plus 1" cannot be said
